newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotels and banks bring down Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Hotels and banks bring down Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Semdex market index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) eased 0.75 points to 394.04 on Wednesday on a fall in the price of hotel and bank stocks, exchange officials said.
The volume transacted rose to 22.79 million rupees ($1.1 million) on 1,010,957 shares, from 23.01 million rupees on 915,533 shares on Monday, the previous trading day.
Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) lost 1.00 rupee to 89.00 rupees on 7,071 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) was unchanged to 13.00 rupees on 401,970 shares.

In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts fell 50 cents to 50.50 rupees on 100,500 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) lost 30 cents to 37.00 rupees on 94,840 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) climbed 30 cents to 46.80 rupees on 800 shares.

Brokers said that falling share prices in hotel and bank stocks did not constitute a real threat to the SEM as the Semdex was compensated by a six percent increase in shares in the conglomerate Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL).

IBL was 1.00 higher to 17.90 rupees on 29,100 shares and Rogers was stable at 105.00 rupees on 26,195 shares. Happy World Foods (HWF) was unchanged at 15.80 rupees on 100,000 shares and Shell fell 30 cents to 20.20 rupees on 4,280 shares.
In the sugar sector, most of the listed stocks were stable and not quoted, except Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) which lost 40 cents to 40.90 on 1,800 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius gained 10 cents to 42.10 rupees on 16,635 shares.
"There have been heavy volume transaction on blue chip stocks and buying interest from foreign and local investors," a broker said.
